main.summary: Describes a client upload or download session persisted in the local working directory.

property.name: ItemId
property.summary: Data item identifier associated with the session.

property.name: WorkingDirectory
property.summary: Local working directory path used to persist session files.

property.name: State
property.summary: Latest known server transfer state for the session.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family currently backing the client session.

property.name: UploadSource
property.summary: Persisted descriptor for the upload source used to reopen or validate resumable upload content.

property.name: SegmentedState
property.summary: Finite segmented transfer state when the session is backed by segmented transport.

property.name: StreamState
property.summary: Stream transfer state when the session is backed by stream transport.

property.name: SupportsLiveFollowBinding
property.summary: Whether the session currently supports client-side live follow binding.
